\int_{-3}^{3}(x+|x|)\,dx=\int_{-3}^{0}0\,dx+\int_{0}^{3}2x\,dx=0+\left[x^2\right]_0^3=9
\]
So
\[
a=2(9)=18.
\]

Expand \(\left(x^{1/2}-x^{-1/3}\right)^{18}\). The general term has exponent
\[
\frac{18-r}{2}-\frac{r}{3}=9-\frac{5r}{6},\quad r=0,1,\dots,18.
\]
This exponent is an integer exactly when \(r\) is divisible by \(6\), i.e. \(r=0,6,12,18\). There are \(4\) such terms.

Total terms \(=19\), so non-integer exponent terms \(=19-4=15\).

\[
